pages.title: Carry a creature home
text: A Soul Urn draws a creature inside. **Use it on a creature** to take it, and **use it on a block** to set it back down there, safe and whole.
It takes anything living except **players**, **bosses** and March **elites**: a cow for the new pen, a villager for the village, a familiar across a river.
Taking a creature is one use and letting it out is another:
An urn will not take a creature when it has only one use left, so you can never trap something you cannot let out. The bar under the urn shows the wear.
